name: THOMAS CHACRA
addressee: To the Underwriting Services team, Zurich Insurance, Zaventem.
subject: Application: Traineeship Insurance Administrator (137418), Thomas Chacra
paragraphs: I am applying for a traineeship in insurance administration with a master's in environmental bioengineering, which is not the usual route into your department and I am aware of that. I am still interested, and for a specific reason: once a deal is signed, someone has to turn it into a policy that says exactly what was agreed, invoices that add up, and a file that holds together when someone asks a question two years later. That is the work I want to learn.

What I have done so far is the same activity in a different vocabulary. I built Excel and Power BI tools that took over recurring reporting, checked and validated the data feeding them, and created a Power Automate system that filed client documents into the right folders instead of leaving them in an inbox. In one analysis, automating the workflow cut processing time to about 30 % of what it had been. None of this is insurance, but all of it is careful administration under a deadline.

The honest gaps: I have no insurance background, no Dutch, and no formal training in finance. Your posting asks for Dutch or French plus English, and French and English I have at C1. I would be starting from the beginning on the insurance side, which is what a traineeship is for, and I would rather say that plainly than imply otherwise.
I would welcome the chance to discuss the three rotations, and I am glad to hear your feedback either way.
